metadata.name: Limacina helicina laboratory carbonate chemistry measurements 2019
metadata.description: Physical and chemical seawater measurements from a laboratory study of the pteropod Limacina helicina collected on 2019‑09‑01 at a single station (48.43 N, ‑126.23 W). Includes temperature, salinity, density, dissolved oxygen, nutrients, pH, pCO₂, DIC, total alkalinity, Omega Arg, Omega Cal, and derived incubation metrics for control and supersaturated treatments. Several columns are duplicates (e.g., Temp vs. Temp_2) and some variables are missing by design for control samples.
